title: x402 to MPP mapping
caption: Header and scheme correspondence published by MPP, consistent with the x402 page. exact maps to charge; upto and batch-settlement are only comparable to sessions. mppx 0.9.0 and later can serve both on one route.
alt: Two columns. x402 V2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED maps to MPP WWW-Authenticate: Payment; PAYMENT-SIGNATURE maps to Authorization: Payment or Payment-Authorization; PAYMENT-RESPONSE maps to Payment-Receipt; scheme exact maps to intent charge; schemes upto and batch-settlement are comparable to per-method session. A note says mppx 0.9.0 and later serves both on one route.
